written.headline: Cognition CISO Alex Stamos on how AI is upending cybersecurity
written.summary: Nilay Patel interviewed Cognition CISO Alex Stamos on The Verge's Decoder podcast about how artificial intelligence is disrupting cybersecurity. Stamos discussed how AI-powered tools are being used by private and state actors to detect and exploit vulnerabilities simultaneously.

written.headline: Tencent's chief AI scientist warns AI bio capabilities will soon risk harm
written.summary: Tencent's chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu stated that artificial intelligence models will soon master biology and present safety risks. He spoke at a science event in Hong Kong following Tencent's launch of its new flagship model, Hy4.

written.headline: IT firms with lower capital requirements may gain as investors shift focus to AI monetisation: Report
written.summary: According to an Anand Rathi report, IT companies capable of monetising enterprise AI without substantial capital investments may gain an advantage. Investors are increasingly differentiating between businesses funding AI infrastructure and those generating returns from its adoption.

written.headline: India's GCCs and IT firms form enterprise AI partnerships
written.summary: Global Capability Centres and Indian IT services firms are forming partnerships to deploy enterprise AI and integrate solutions across large organizations. A new study by ANSR and HFS Research scored India's GCC ecosystem at 61.9, noting that 83% of GCCs are mission-critical while only 17% have full budget authority.

written.headline: South Korea says Nvidia issues won't affect contracted GPU supplies
written.summary: South Korea expects its contracted deliveries of Nvidia graphics processing units to proceed without disruption despite a controversy involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Vice Minister of Science and ICT Ryu Jemyung stated that 10,000 GPUs funded under a 2025 budget have already arrived and are in use.
